about: tools/bench_contrastive.py -- the contrastive backlog's one harness (E0.1/E0.3/E0.4/E1.2/E2.2). Each section records the command that reproduces it and the sha256 of every input.

repro.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA repro
repro.protocol: w1 probe_proto: init = first K=5 train wordings/intent (unit mean), one shuffled pass over n_stream other train wordings (decide, then learn), test top-1 with the final prototypes; noise = with prob r the label is a uniformly random WRONG intent among the arm's top-8

reproduction.metric: E1.2 kept negative: reverse normalisation cost (points)
E1.2 reverse normalisation with same-label exclusion, lam 0.5 (points)

teacher.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA teacher
teacher.protocol: w1 probe_gate: static MeaningIndex with K=10 wordings/intent; 1,600 calibration verdicts (1,500 train + 100 oos_train), 1,800 test questions (1,500 + 300 oos_test); 100 re-asks for eps_hat (TeacherNoise with m = mean candidates - 1); serve bar 0.95

reproduction.note: the panel's 0.107 is 0.1065 rounded twice; the 4-digit probe value is the strict check

reproduction.metric: eps-corrected static gate, CLINC150 10% noise: served correct (%)
eps-corrected static gate, CLINC150 10% noise: served wrong (%)
uncorrected gate today, CLINC150 10% noise: served (%)

reproduction.note: 0.988 is 0.9875 rounded twice; the 4-digit probe value is the strict check

learned.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA --index idx_clinc.json learned
learned.protocol: w4 p0/p2b/p3: the learned index scored as MeaningIndex.rank does (0.2 best wording + 0.8 centroid); InfoNCE prototypes trained on the index's own 8,591 wordings (tau .05, eta .03, 4 epochs, blend readout: w4's val-chosen config); AURC under the 4,500:1,000 prior on test in-scope + oos_test half B

reproduction.metric: InfoNCE on the learned index, seed 0

reproduction.note: the panel's 0.086 is 0.0855 (0.08546) rounded twice; the 4-digit probe value is the strict check

learned.configs_tried: 1 here (w4's val grid: 4 InfoNCE x 4 epoch checkpoints x 2 readouts, 3 AdaptHD x 4 x 2)

prior_trap.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA --index idx_clinc.json prior-trap

reproduction.metric: P0.97 coverage, threshold on prior-reweighted val (%)
P0.97 coverage, E0.4 protocol (val + oos half A) (%)
P0.97 coverage, threshold on UNweighted val (%)

prior_trap.lesson: coverage at EXACTLY one precision is a knife-edge statistic: the same index reads 37.7% or 3.3% at P=0.97 depending on which 100-odd out-of-scope questions calibrate it. Report AURC and precision at fixed served fractions first; a calibrated operating point only with its realised precision, out-of-scope served and a paired CI (gate_protocol).

gate.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA gate
gate.protocol: E0.4: calibrate on val in-scope + sha256 half A of CLINC oos_test; report on test in-scope + half B; precision under the 4,500:1,000 prior; AURC; precision at 20-60% served; realised precision / coverage / wrong / out-of-scope at thresholds calibrated for P 0.95 / 0.97 and for <= 1.5% served-wrong; oracle thresholds only as a symmetric diagnostic; 3 seeds; paired bootstrap (1,000 resamples, seed 0) InfoNCE minus AdaptHD on the same report questions

negq.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA negq
negq.protocol:
corrections? Rows = CLINC150 intents with K = 10 confirmed wordings; calibration = val + oos_val (perfect
    teacher: the flag threshold allowing 1% false flags); report = test + oos_test, perfect teacher (false flags)
    and 10% / 20% planted noise (AUROC, planted recall). ACCEPTANCE: AUROC >= 0.8 AND <= 1% false flags.

variants.draft: 1 - max cos(q, the negative row A's own confirmed wordings) (holographic_protostore.negative_quality)
variants.eci_wording_margin: ECI Delta_max: max cos(q, wordings of the teacher's pick B) - max cos(q, wordings of A); a 'new' verdict's positive is q itself (cos 1)
variants.prototype_margin: cos(q, prototype of B) - cos(q, prototype of A) ('new' -> B = q)
variants.pick_rank: 1 - (rank of B - 2) / 6: genuine corrections concentrate on the runner-up, noise spreads over ranks 2..8 ('new' -> 1)

negq.acceptance: AUROC >= 0.8 at flagging planted errors (10% noise) AND <= 1% false flags, perfect teacher

verdict.draft_as_specified: draft/quality (HM of hardness and 1 - best cosine to A's wordings) is a KEPT NEGATIVE whenever its AUROC is below 0.5: hardness REWARDS the teacher's errors -- a false negative is the hardest negative there is

miner.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA miner
miner.protocol:
prototypes actually confuse on TEST better than a centroid-cosine miner? precision@K against the test-confused
    unordered pairs (>= 1 and >= 2 confusions), 3 seeds, paired bootstrap over test questions.

miners.protostore_M: ProtoStore.confusion mass, M[a][b] + M[b][a] (the E1.2 miner)
miners.centroid_cosine: cosine between unit centroids of every TRAIN wording the store saw (true labels) -- the baseline named in the acceptance
miners.prototype_cosine: cosine between the final learned prototypes
miners.stream_errors: count of prequential misses (y, pred) during the stream; ties by pair id

curriculum.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA curriculum
curriculum.protocol:
(where the panel saw +0.4..+0.7) and K = 5 seed wordings, clean and 10% noise, 3 seeds, paired CIs. Plus a
    DIAGNOSTIC arm whose row maturity counts the seeding wordings (the probe's `nrow`; ProtoStore counts verdicts
    only, so its rows all start 'young').

reproduction.metric: ProtoStore InfoNCE, Banking77 K=1 seed 0, clean
ProtoStore InfoNCE, Banking77 K=1 seed 0, 10% noise

systemone.command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 tools/bench_contrastive.py --data DATA systemone
systemone.protocol: w1: K=5 examples/intent (file order), 3,000-verdict shuffled one-pass stream through SystemOne.observe (decide first, then learn), test top-1 with SystemOne.decide; encoder = the harness's cached hashed char 3-5-grams d=2048 (SystemOne.hashed_ngram_encode's arithmetic)
